subject.title: Feature: Native Audio Input for Omni-Modal Models (skip STT transcription)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio attachments to the core/channel media-to-model contract, and what raw-media egress, fallback, and transcript/audit policy should govern that path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes normalized model content, provider routing, sensitive media egress, session continuity, and user-facing config policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design native-audio contract first
options.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, explicit raw-media egress, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

options.title: Keep STT-only for now
options.body: Leave inbound voice notes on the current transcription path until native audio policy and provider support are mature enough to expose safely.

options.title: Adopt and rework candidate PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78797 only after it is rebased and reworked to the approved contract with stronger real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Design native-audio contract first
recommendation.body: Settle typed audio blocks, provider serialization, explicit raw-media egress, fallback behavior, payload limits, and transcript/audit metadata before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail and core media/provider contract scope make steipete the best available routing owner for the product contract decision.
